implemented: Tiny ARC Objective-C target guards private icon class/selector ABI, wraps factory/setter/getter, content/request copying and icon submission in Objective-C exception boundaries.
Icon applied to a content copy; untouched public content retained for sole ordinary fallback. No KVC, sender substitution, helper app, entitlement changes or fake person.
Existing bounded PNG validation retained; phone badge now Apple SF Symbols iphone in local circular blue/white badge.
Removed right attachments, temporary file staging and artwork cache. No synthetic artwork when optional source is missing or invalid.

Outstanding decorated submissions capped at128, including obsolete requests awaiting callbacks. Current token required before one plain retry. Replacement, tombstone, context clear, reply and dismissal revoke retry authority.
Native action handler exposed internally for deterministic response tests; HFP rendering/control branch unchanged.

cases: Missing class/selector and mismatched constructor ABI return nil without modifying ordinary content.
Injected failed icon construction still delivers ordinary text and actions without attachments.
Preserved byte/type/frame/dimension/static PNG rejection and sanitized subtitle coverage.
One plain retry; no retry after replacement/tombstone/pair switch/dismiss/reply; one-shot reply retains package/peer/token.
Pending icon count remains bounded even when the same source notification is repeatedly replaced.
tests.limits: Compiler/test outcome pending parent. Tests inject icon request creation for deterministic delivery failure; live private-object serialization proven only by parent probe, not newly executed here.

previewAPI: @MainActor NotificationArtwork.renderedPNG(base64: String) -> Data? remains standalone. Uses AppKit/ImageIO/UniformTypeIdentifiers only.
privateAPIRisks: Undocumented selectors may disappear, change signatures, throw, or be ignored by the notification daemon. Guard/exception fallback is ordinary notification, never right-hand artwork.
Successful construction/copy/submission does not establish left placement, badge rendering, mask behavior, or compatibility on other macOS versions. Parent native screenshot required.
cleanup: This patch creates no temporary files. Earlier artwork staging namespace was NSTemporaryDirectory()/com.thekozugroup.plink.notification-artwork; parent owns cleanup of earlier-build leftovers after old submissions finish.

changes: All asynchronous submissions now acquire a current per-ID token, including ordinary fallback. Completion releases pending icon tracking before gating every subsequent effect by current ownership.
Dismiss uses shared pending/delivered removal before dropping bookkeeping.
